title: Speed at Q
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the ball's speed at Q using energy conservation (mgR = ½mv²).

title: Plate voltage
description: Important: Recognizes that for straight-line constant velocity, electric force equals weight (qU/d = mg).

title: Circuit current
description: Important: Correctly finds the current through R0 using Ohm's law with the plate voltage.

title: Motor terminal voltage
description: Important: Applies Kirchhoff's loop rule to find voltage across motor (UM = E - U - Ir).

title: Mechanical power output
description: Essential: Correctly computes motor's mechanical power as electrical input minus Joule heating (IUM - I²rM).

title: Sign/unit errors
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in loop equation or uses incorrect units for charge/mass.

title: Force balance condition
description: Pitfall: Fails to equate electric and gravitational forces for straight-line constant velocity.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Optional: Explicitly identifies parallel circuit relationship between plate voltage and R0 voltage.
